english: Let $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$ and $\overrightarrow{c}$ be vectors such that $|\overrightarrow{a}|=1$, $|\overrightarrow{b}|=2$, $|\overrightarrow{c}|=1$, $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=1$, $\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=1$ and $\overrightarrow{c}\cdot\overrightarrow{a}=\frac12$. Then the volume of the parallelepiped whose coterminous edges are $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$ and $\overrightarrow{c}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि सदिश $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{c}$ इस प्रकार हैं कि $|\overrightarrow{a}|=1$, $|\overrightarrow{b}|=2$, $|\overrightarrow{c}|=1$, $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=1$, $\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=1$ तथा $\overrightarrow{c}\cdot\overrightarrow{a}=\frac12$ है। तब उस समान्तर षट्फलक का आयतन, जिसकी संलग्न (coterminous) कोरें $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{c}$ हैं, ______ है।
solution: Row-by-row multiplication of $\det M$ with $\det M^{T}=\det M$: $[\overrightarrow{a}\ \overrightarrow{b}\ \overrightarrow{c}]^{2}=\begin{vmatrix}\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{a}&\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}&\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}\\\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{a}&\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}&\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}\\\overrightarrow{c}\cdot\overrightarrow{a}&\overrightarrow{c}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}&\overrightarrow{c}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}\end{vmatrix}$
solution_full: Write $\overrightarrow{a}=(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ and so on, and let $M$ be the matrix with rows $\overrightarrow{a},\overrightarrow{b},\overrightarrow{c}$. Then $\det M=[\overrightarrow{a}\ \overrightarrow{b}\ \overrightarrow{c}]$, the scalar triple product, whose absolute value is the volume.
Multiply $\det M$ by $\det M^{T}$ (equal to $\det M$) row by column: the $(i,j)$ entry of the product is the dot product of the $i$-th and $j$-th vectors.
The data are consistent: the leading minors $1$, $4-1=3$ and $2$ are positive, so such vectors exist.
Hence the volume is $\sqrt2=1.41421\ldots$, which is $1.41$ to two decimal places.
originality_note: New use: the multiplication theorem det(M) det(M^T) = det(M M^T) turns six given dot products into the square of a scalar triple product (way 5). Closest known: the Gram identity [a b c]^2 = det of dot products, usually stated as a formula. Different because: the vectors are not given in components, so the product of determinants is the only route.

concept_use.Multiplication of Determinants: det M times det M^T, multiplied row by column, gives the determinant of dot products, which equals [a b c]^2.

stem_review: Read as a student: vectors in space, all magnitudes and dot products given; 'coterminous edges' standard; data consistent (Gram matrix positive definite). Checked: Gram determinant 2, volume sqrt 2 = 1.41421 (no rounding boundary). Answer 1.41, a positive decimal as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Square of the triple product equals the determinant of dot products by multiplying det M with det M^T.
justification: One known identity from the multiplication theorem and a numeric 3x3 determinant; routine with a recall step. Comparable to 2021-P1-Q19 (L3) on the same data type but simpler; placed at L2 like 2026-P2-Q1 (L2).
